scope: A macOS ARM64 LibreCAD PR #3289 candidate rebuilt from source with the shared current codec opened, saved at AC1015 and reopened a locally generated two-XRECORD layout witness. The source DXF came from a scratch-only legacy guard-bypassed adapter.
buildMethod: Clean consumer build against the shared codec, then a single test-only organization-name substitution to isolate settings and avoid recursively scanning the user Documents library. The test source was restored after the build. The path-selected process was checked to map the listed codec. The later libdxfrw commit fcec62f8a changes only the dwg2dxf adapter, test/research and qualification metadata for this profile; the shared-codec implementation is the same.
observations: Native same-version save completed without an omission dialog; the saved drawing was reopened and its line rendered.

Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 checks AC1015, original line, Model and Layout1, layout reactor, extension dictionary ownership and its distinct RESEARCH/CHECK/37 and SECOND/OTHER/73 XRECORD children; audit reports zero errors and fixes.

The reopened application displayed duplicate Model tabs: its UI adds a synthetic Model tab and separately displays the imported model layout. This is a consumer UI issue; retained object metadata remains necessary.
limits: Test-only settings isolation changes application organization identity; this is not a byte-identical release build.
One generated, guard-bypassed profile and one platform; no native AutoCAD clone semantics, cross-platform or general release qualification. No drawing file is committed.
